purpose: Verify the newly staged documentation chronology and derived evidence; preserve delivery-v3 production behavior and existing acceptance limits.

phases.name: evidence-readback
command:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess
root=Path('/Users/qinyingying/.codex/worktrees/nw-mainline-refresh-20261016/storyforge')
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
allowed={'tests/acceptance/narrative-world/README.md':'31a18432b15f342df3389fb4b4e48d7951f0ace823406d5ef563472dea0a272b','docs/products/WORLD-ENGINE.md':'2a8b5eaa96288d24122309c09b47c3273d3bf91d548723e88fa574065145ad98'}
pin=json.loads(Path('/tmp/nw-impact-sequence-20261022-v1/delivery-v3/validation-sources.json').read_text())
for path,digest in pin['files'].items():assert sha(root/path)==allowed.get(path,digest),path
for group in ['runtimeFiles','extraFiles','executionFiles']:
 for path,digest in pin[group].items():assert sha(path)==digest,path
assert sha('/tmp/nw-impact-sequence-20261022-v1/delivery-v3/validation.py')==pin['runnerSha256']
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only','cd124ccb03bff0695b4c8faa5b78cddf4906a128'],cwd=root,text=True).strip()==''
scope=json.loads(Path('/tmp/nw-local-engineering-checkpoint-20261022-v1/supplement-scope.json').read_text())
for item in scope['paths']:assert sha(root/item['path'])==item['sha256'],item['path']
baseline=json.loads((root/'tests/acceptance/narrative-world/baseline-20261022-nw2d-v79.json').read_text())
for path,digest in baseline['input']['hashes'].items():assert sha(root/path)==digest,path
receipt=json.loads((root/'tests/acceptance/narrative-world/impact-sequence-post-delivery-docs-v1-20261022.json').read_text())
assert receipt['exitCode']==0 and receipt['allInputsUnchanged']
assert len({f['path'] for f in receipt['files']})==len(receipt['files'])
for f in receipt['files']:assert sha(root/f['path'])==f['sha256'],f['path']
cross=json.loads((root/'tests/acceptance/narrative-world/cross-product-current-evidence-20261022-v1.json').read_text())
assert sha(root/cross['sourceDraft']['path'])==cross['sourceDraft']['sha256']
assert cross['matchedReferences']==cross['references']==32 and cross['areas']==8
report={'sameProductionAsPassedDeliveryV3':True,'reviewedDocumentation':allowed,'supplementPathsVerified':len(scope['paths']),'baselineHashesVerified':len(baseline['input']['hashes']),'archivePathsVerified':len(receipt['files']),'crossProductReferences':32,'modelCalls':0,'performanceAcceptance':False,'semanticQualityAcceptance':False,'humanAcceptance':False}
path=Path('/tmp/nw-impact-sequence-20261022-v1/checkpoint-final-docs-v1/evidence-readback.json')
path.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False))
